nldas.title: Label check: NLDAS-2 Noah 10-40 cm vs FLDAS
lines: Development cells 2016-2023: 1,338,912 cell-months; Spearman correlation of percentiles 0.640; drought flags agree 80.8% of the time, Cohen's kappa 0.458; AUC of the NLDAS percentile for the FLDAS flag 0.824; drought rate FLDAS 0.221, NLDAS 0.238.

Fresh-test cells 2025-01..2026-09: 75,096 cell-months; Spearman correlation of percentiles 0.510; drought flags agree 70.8% of the time, Cohen's kappa 0.364; AUC of the NLDAS percentile for the FLDAS flag 0.740; drought rate FLDAS 0.394, NLDAS 0.310.
